_readme: Hand-curated layer. Every fact carries cites[] = { f: repo-relative file, q: verbatim quote }. scripts/build-data.mjs merges this with books/cardinal/_project/event-ledger.csv into dataset.json; tests/data.test.mjs re-checks every quote against the repo. Unknown stays unknown: if a field is not here, the UI says so.

ledger.excludedActorsNote: Rows whose actors are all institutions (US Congress, Supreme Court, companies, groups) are not people-events and stay out of this dataset.
